players.product: PECVD (Stack ONO, ACHM hard-mask) and ALD thin-film deposition tools for 3D NAND and advanced memory, plus hybrid-bonding tools

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026: revenue RMB 2.91 billion, +49.06% year on year, as advanced products passed customer validation in volume; net profit attributable RMB 1.34 billion, +1,324.10%, helped by about RMB 960 million more fair-value gains on financial assets; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 367.33 million, +861.92%. Gross margin rose about 9 percentage points on scale effects and new products in volume production.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 2,912.86 million (+49.06%); net profit RMB 1,342.75 million (+1,324.10%); recurring net profit RMB 367.33 million (+861.92%)

quarterly_data.signal: PECVD Stack (ONO), ACHM hard-mask series, OPN, SiB and Bianca tools for advanced memory and advanced logic are in scaled volume production with repeat batch orders; PE-ALD SiO2 and SiCO tools are ramping in advanced memory with repeat orders; the higher-throughput NF-300M Supra-H for multilayer ONO stacks is in process optimisation and validation; PECVD tools were shipped to overseas customers. Cumulative shipments exceed 3,800 reaction chambers (over 480 pX and Supra-D), in about 100 production lines, with average uptime above 90% and about 600 million wafers processed.
quarterly_data.figure: over 3,800 reaction chambers shipped (over 480 pX / Supra-D); about 100 production lines; uptime over 90%

quarterly_data.signal: Order book: management says orders on hand are full and support full-year deliveries and growth; new customers were added and overseas orders won. Contract liabilities stood at RMB 5.13 billion at 30 June 2026.

3D integration: the Dione 300 wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonder is commercialised and won orders in H1 2026; the next-generation Dione 300eX is progressing in customer validation; the Pleione die-to-wafer hybrid bonder (for HBM and 3D chip integration) is in customer validation; die-to-wafer fusion bonding and post-bond laser debonding tools won customer orders; bonding-overlay metrology won new customer orders.
Capacity: the Shenyang second plant (over 150,000 square metres planned) has topped out and is expected to be completed and in use in 2028, adding capacity for PECVD, SACVD and HDPCVD tools.
quarterly_data.figure: over 150,000 square metres planned; completion expected 2028

Piotech.why: Chinese PECVD / ALD deposition-tool maker whose Stack (ONO) and ACHM hard-mask tools are in volume production for advanced memory; 3D NAND fab capex drives its revenue.
Piotech.evidence: Piotech 2026 half-year report: PECVD Stack (ONO), ACHM series and PE-ALD tools in scaled volume production for advanced memory with repeat batch orders.
